articles.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday. VIX and bitcoin say the fear may fade Monday.
articles.snippet: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin suggest the same.

articles.title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange already paid up, but a court order and restrictions from its 2025 settlement will not be lifted even though the CFTC said the case should have never been presented.

articles.title: Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
articles.snippet: Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.

articles.title: Capital B reports $78M H1 loss driven by Bitcoin impairment charge
articles.snippet: Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury raised $30 million and increased its Bitcoin holdings by 11% in the first half of 2026, despite reporting a $75 million Bitcoin impairment loss.

articles.title: Balaji’s ‘Singapore of social media’ begins with a wave of bans
articles.snippet: Network School founder Balaji Srinivasan wants to turn Farcaster into a haven for well-mannered techno-optimists. He had to do a bit of housekeeping first.
